name: The Sea God Surveys (iQPS Launch 9)
agency: Institute for Q-shu Pioneers of Space
location_str: Unknown Pad @ Rocket Lab Launch Complex 1, NZL
destination_explanation: Even at this height there are faint wisps of atmosphere. They slowly drag satellites down, so anything here needs an occasional push to stay up.
slot_a_text: It has already slipped twice. The current time was set 10 days ago and has held since. There is a 2.3-hour window to work with.
slot_b_text: Rocket Lab's 20th launch of the year, 99th all time. Their year has run at a launch every couple of weeks. No Electron has failed in 57 flights.
